# Code of Conduct

VitalsDA follows a code of conduct based on the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/). Be respectful, assume good faith, and keep
discussion constructive and technical.

## Our standards

Examples of behaviour that contributes to a positive environment include using welcoming and inclusive
language, respecting differing viewpoints and experiences, and accepting constructive criticism
gracefully.

Examples of unacceptable behaviour include harassment, insulting or derogatory comments, public or
private harassment, and publishing others' private information without explicit permission.

## Scope

This code applies in every VitalsDA space: repositories, issues, pull requests, and any event or channel
where someone represents VitalsDA.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behaviour privately through the **Security** tab of
[VitalsDA/.github](https://github.com/VitalsDA/.github/security), then **Report a vulnerability**
(GitHub private vulnerability reporting). Reports are handled confidentially by the maintainers.

## Enforcement

Maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing the standards, and will take appropriate, fair
corrective action in response to any behaviour they deem inappropriate, threatening, offensive or
harmful.
